RIVEN:

Use the provided RIVEN reference image for Riven.

Keep Riven consistent with the provided reference throughout the entire video.

There is only ONE Riven.

Do not use Riven's appearance for any other character.

Riven is holding her original large sword.

The sword is COMPLETELY INTACT throughout this entire scene.

The sword must NOT break.

Riven is completely REACTIVE in this scene.

Riven does NOT attack the Mystery Figure.

Riven does NOT charge forward.

Riven does NOT initiate combat.

She only sees the threat, becomes confused,
raises her sword defensively,
and is suddenly overwhelmed.


MYSTERY FIGURE:

Use the provided MYSTERY FIGURE reference image
as the visual identity of the mysterious attacker.

There is only ONE Mystery Figure.

Keep its overall mysterious dark form consistent with the reference.

However, throughout this scene,
the Mystery Figure must remain difficult to see clearly.

It is partially hidden by:

dense smoke,
darkness,
orange firelight,
and motion blur.

Do NOT clearly reveal its face.

Do NOT clearly reveal its exact body structure.

Do NOT clearly reveal how it attacks.

Do NOT clearly reveal a weapon.

Do NOT show the Mystery Figure punching Riven.

Do NOT show a normal hand attack.

Do NOT show a conventional sword attack.

The Mystery Figure never speaks.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are exactly TWO active figures:

1. Riven
2. Mystery Figure

No Father.

No soldiers.

No Ally Soldier.

No villagers.

No additional characters.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided BURNING VILLAGE reference
as the environment reference.

Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence
as the starting visual continuity.

The entire scene takes place inside the SAME burning village.

Thick smoke fills the village street.

Burning wooden buildings create strong orange firelight
through the dark smoke.

Ash and embers drift through the air.

Visibility is limited.

No location change.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Grounded realistic human anatomy.

Realistic physical impact.

Natural hair, cloth, smoke, ash and fire physics.

Cinematic camera movement.

Keep the scene visually SIMPLE.

Keep the Mystery Figure visually UNCLEAR.

Avoid excessive cuts.

No extended combat.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.

No background music.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Riven stands inside the burning village.

She looks confused and unsettled.

Through the dense smoke and fire ahead,
she can barely see the vague shape of the Mystery Figure.

Riven does not understand what she is seeing.

She cautiously raises her intact sword
into a defensive position.

Riven remains completely defensive.

Then—

without warning—

the vague dark figure suddenly accelerates
through the smoke at extreme speed.

Its movement is so fast
that its exact attack cannot be clearly understood.

The Mystery Figure becomes a fast dark motion
surging through the smoke.

A sudden violent impact hits Riven.

Riven is completely overwhelmed.

She is thrown backward.

Her intact sword flies out of her hands.

Riven crashes onto the ground.

CUT.

Riven stands inside the burning village.

Firelight flickers across her face.

Smoke moves behind her.


Riven looks forward.


Her expression is confused,

uneasy,

and increasingly alarmed.


She does not move toward the threat.


CUT TO:


Riven's view into the burning village.


Through thick smoke and orange firelight,

the MYSTERY FIGURE is barely visible in the distance.


Keep the figure vague.


Only a dark ambiguous silhouette
can be perceived through the smoke.


The audience cannot clearly understand
what they are looking at.


Do not bring the figure into clear view.


CUT BACK TO:


Riven.


Riven continues staring at the vague figure.


She does not understand what it is.


Riven slowly brings her INTACT sword up with both hands.


She takes a defensive stance.


Riven remains completely passive and defensive.


She does NOT move toward the Mystery Figure.


She does NOT attack.


She waits.


Then—


SUDDENLY:


The Mystery Figure explosively accelerates
through the dense smoke toward Riven.


Do NOT show normal running.


Do NOT clearly show individual footsteps.


Do NOT show a conventional attack animation.


Instead,


the vague dark silhouette becomes a rapid dark motion
surging through the smoke.


Its movement is extremely fast,

brief,

and difficult to visually read.


Smoke violently shifts around the movement.


For a fraction of a moment,

the dark form crosses the distance toward Riven.


Riven cannot follow the movement.


She cannot react in time.


Before she can properly defend herself—


IMPACT.


A sudden violent force strikes Riven.


Do NOT clearly reveal what physically struck her.


Do NOT clearly show a hand.


Do NOT clearly show a weapon.


Do NOT explain the attack.


The audience should only understand that
the Mystery Figure moved incredibly fast

and Riven was suddenly hit.


The impact violently throws Riven backward.


Riven loses her grip on the sword.


Her INTACT sword flies out of her hands.


Riven crashes hard onto the ground.


The sword hits the dirt separately
and slides away from her.


Riven remains conscious,

but completely stunned.


Do NOT continue the fight.


CUT.

Riven is lying on the ground.

Riven is conscious but stunned.

Riven has NOT attacked the Mystery Figure.

Riven has NOT successfully blocked the attack.


Riven is NOT holding her sword.

The sword has NOT broken.

several feet away from Riven.


The Mystery Figure has NOT been clearly revealed.

Its attack method remains unknown.

No clear weapon has been shown.

No clear physical attack has been shown.

RIVEN COULD NOT REACT.

A VIOLENT IMPACT THREW RIVEN TO THE GROUND.

HER INTACT SWORD FLEW AWAY.


CUT.

Unsettling.

Sudden.

Overwhelming.

Do not explain its attack.

CONFUSED RIVEN.

CUT.

VAGUE MYSTERY FIGURE INSIDE SMOKE AND FIRE.

CUT.

RIVEN RAISES HER INTACT SWORD DEFENSIVELY.

SUDDEN DARK MOTION THROUGH THE SMOKE.

IMPACT.

RIVEN IS VIOLENTLY THROWN BACKWARD.

THE INTACT SWORD FLIES FROM HER HAND.

RIVEN HITS THE GROUND.

CUT.
